newsitem.title: CANADA: CT Financial jumps on takeover report.
newsitem.headline: CT Financial jumps on takeover report.

text.p: Shares in CT Financial Services Inc jumped in light trading on Friday after the company and its parent denied a published report that it was in takeover talks with Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce.
CT stock was up 7.50 at 47.50 on light volume of 700 shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
The stock resumed trading after CT's majority owner, Imasco Ltd, said it was not in discussions with CIBC to sell the financial services firm.
The TSE halted trading in CT after Toronto's Financial Post reported on Friday that CIBC was in "top secret talks" to acquire Canada Trust in a possible C$4.8 billion deal.
"It's all rumor and speculation and as such not worthy of comment," Canada Trust spokesman Mark Towhey told Reuters.
Imasco owns about 98 percent of the common shares of CT, parent of the Canada Trust group of companies.
CIBC declined comment on the report.
Shares in CIBC gained 0.60 to 38.25 in Toronto.
Imasco shares were up 0.95 to 42.60 in afternoon trading, but off a 52-week high of 44.50 earlier in the session.
